title: It’s SO organized (read it,it’s pretty short)
body: If you install it I PROMISE you’re going to be happier with yourself and be proud of the things you did and it will keep you organized for example: the Ai first gives you something for the morning routine like making the bed then you can choose whatever you want to do next like stretch,drink water,go brush your teeth so many options and you can put a Specific amount of time, you can add any amount of hours,minutes and even SECONDS.
